explication: Perfetto is a system-tracing and trace-analysis suite. Its principal workflow is to configure tracing, collect userspace and OS events through SDKs, probes, and tracing daemons, then inspect the resulting trace in the browser UI or analyze it with SQL. The graph also includes trace-processor storage and execution layers. The README documents the product capabilities; sampled source excerpts expose some implementation details, but not enough to verify every runtime connection.
